educationalGoal: This course is a continuation of Japanese Basics 1 and aims to help students devel op the four basic skills of communication (reading, writing, speaking, and listeni ng) in modern Japanese. By the end of this course, students will be able to handle wider varieties of conversation situations and be able to read and write simple l etters and essays. Students will also be familiar with various aspects of Japanese culture including sociolinguistic facts about accurate communication.
advice: Five chapters (Lesson 11 - Lesson 15) will be covered and 78 new kanji will be introduced. L11: After the Vacation (R&W: Looking for Friends/Members) L12: Feeling Ill (R&W: Tanabata Festival) L13: Looking for a Part-time Job (R&W: Interesting Experiences in Japan) L14: Valentine’s Day (R&W: Personal Advice Column) L15: A Trip to Nagano (R&W: My Favorite Place)
books: 教科書:(A)Genki 1 & 2: An Integraded Course in Elementary Japanese, Third Edition[ジャパンタイムズ出版] (B) Genki 1 & 2 Workbook[ジャパンタイムズ出版]
requiredKnowledge: Japanese Basics 1 with a grade of C or higher. Transfer students or students seeking to take this course after a break of one semester or more from their study of Japanese must take a placement test. Talk to the head instruc tor immediately if you need to take the placement test.

achievementLevels.ideal: ・Speaking: Carry out simple conversations and answer qu estions regarding the topics using the target expression s orally including details and opinions. ・Listening: Listen and understand the content of each u nit perfectly. ・Reading: Understand the main points of the text comple tely. ・Vocabulary & grammar: Understand the meaning of import ant vocabulary and expressions in each unit and use them appropriately. ・Autonomy: Become an independent learner by studying Ja panese regularly on their own.
achievementLevels.standard: ・Speaking: Carry out simple conversations and answer qu estions regarding the topic using the target expressions orally in simple sentences. ・Listening: Listen and und erstand the overall content of the unit. ・Reading: Unde rstand the main points of the text. ・Vocabulary & gramm ar: Understand the meaning of important vocabulary and e xpressions in each unit and, though not perfectly, use t hem to form simple sentences. ・Autonomy: Become an inde pendent learner by studying Japanese regularly on their own.
